source_name: ATMIA showroom — vendor profiles
why_relevant: Industry-association vendor showroom listing self-service suppliers and their materials; a stable pointer for enumerating the vendor universe (including smaller software vendors) before hunting country references.

source_name: Finextra — vendor company news pages (e.g. Tietoevry, BPC, OpenWay)
why_relevant: Per-vendor news archives carrying vendor-issued customer-win announcements. Because it archives releases by vendor, it is an efficient way to reconstruct a vendor's disclosed deal history including any Ukrainian entries.

source_name: Private Banker International — payment platform selection news
why_relevant: Trade-press coverage of OpenWay WAY4 selections; useful corroboration layer for vendor claims and for capturing deals reported to media but not published as vendor case studies.

source_name: BPC Group / SmartVista corporate and regional sites
why_relevant: BPC opened a Ukrainian office in 2004 and grew SmartVista business there; the vendor's own site and its historic regional variants are the primary record for UA processing deployments. Note the RU-domiciled spin-offs (bps-iss.ru, bpsprocessing.ru) that now carry legacy SmartVista content — separate entity, compliance-sensitive.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — vendor case-study pages removed after 2022
why_relevant: Several vendors (notably Diebold Nixdorf, which divested Russia/Ukraine assets) removed or de-listed Ukraine-related customer references. Archived snapshots are often the only surviving evidence of pre-2022 vendor-bank relationships and installed base.

source_name: NBU newsroom — important payment infrastructure objects list
why_relevant: The regulator names systemically important payment systems, infrastructure operators and technology operators annually. That list identifies which vendor/processor entities actually carry Ukrainian volume — an authoritative cross-check on vendor marketing claims.

source_name: Servus Systems Integration (ТОВ «Сервус Сістемз Інтегрейшн», SSI)
why_relevant: Self-described leading Ukrainian systems integrator for payment systems and self-service, 25+ years. Homepage carries an explicit vendor-partner logo wall (Verifone, Hyosung TNS, IBM, Sargent & Greenleaf, Qnet, Caxton) and a client logo wall (PrivatBank, Oschadbank, UkrSibBank, OTP Bank, PUMB, A-Bank, Ukrposhta, Kyivstar, DTEK). This is exactly the layer that reveals which global ATM/POS brands are actually deployed in UA and who holds the service relationship.

source_name: ПУСК — Перша Українська Сервісна Компанія (First Ukrainian Service Company)
why_relevant: Multi-vendor contract-service company for geographically distributed estates including banking infrastructure and POS terminals. Publicly states service coverage of 40+ brands (NCR, Wincor/Diebold Nixdorf, Verifone, Ingenico, PAX, Datecs, Epson, Honeywell, DIGI, Ricoh) and names clients (UkrSibBank, Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta, Silpo, Novus, ATB-adjacent retail, OKKO, METRO). Direct evidence of who competes for maintenance contracts across bank + retail estates.

source_name: SystemGroup Ukraine
source_subtype: distributor/integrator site with project case studies
why_relevant: Large Ukrainian business-automation distributor/integrator presented in search results as an official Ukrainian partner of NCR, Diebold Nixdorf, Sewoo and Shuttle for POS and self-service kiosks. Maintains a project/case-study section (e.g. self-service terminals for VIYAR showrooms) — rare published UA deployment references. Separate service arm at service.systemgroup.com.ua.

source_name: Бан Ком Сервіс (Ban Com Service) — ATM service company
why_relevant: Pure-play ATM service company explicitly advertising repair, spare-parts replacement and preventive maintenance for GRG, NCR and Wincor Nixdorf machines. Displays ~30 partner logos. Confirms which ATM fleets exist in Ukraine and identifies an independent maintenance competitor.

source_name: UMICON (ЮМІКОН) — banking cash-equipment service centre
why_relevant: 17-year Ukrainian supplier and authorised service centre for cash-handling equipment (banknote counters/sorters, coin sorters, detectors, packaging, CIT security solutions) with a declared nationwide service-partner network. Client logo wall present. Maps the cash-equipment sub-segment and its regional sub-contractor chain.

source_name: Cassida Ukraine — exclusive UA distributor
why_relevant: Self-declared official/exclusive Ukrainian distributor of the Cassida brand (money counters, detectors, sorters). Concrete example of a single-brand exclusive distribution arrangement in the cash-equipment layer; useful for mapping brand-to-distributor exclusivity in UA.

source_name: Deep2000 — banking equipment supplier / Kisan & Ribao UA distributor
why_relevant: Described in search results as official exclusive Ukrainian distributor of Kisan and Ribao, supplying deposit systems and cash-handling solutions to banks. Adds another brand-to-distributor mapping and a competitor in bank cash-centre equipment.

source_name: УХЛ-МАШ — banking equipment catalogue
why_relevant: Ukrainian supplier of certified cash-transport and cash-counting equipment for banks. Its banking-equipment catalogue reveals which foreign brands are certified and stocked for the UA bank market.

source_name: БАНКСПЕЦЗАХИСТ (pod-zamkom.com.ua) — bank safes & deposit systems
why_relevant: Supplier of deposit safes and bank-grade security equipment (e.g. VALBERG models) for bank cash centres and CIT vehicles, a segment the NBU regulates. Indirectly reveals which security-equipment brands are approved for UA banking use.

source_name: ВЕНБЕСТ — bank & ATM physical security and cash escort
why_relevant: One of Ukraine's largest private security operators (since 1991, ~79,000 protected objects) with a dedicated bank/ATM protection and valuables-escort service line and 20+ years of bank clients. The security/CIT-adjacent layer that co-services the ATM estate; regional branch pages reveal geographic coverage.

source_name: CIT Security (ТОВ «СІТ СЕК'ЮРІТІ») — cash-in-transit operator
why_relevant: Specialised non-bank CIT operator with explicit service lines for banks, legal entities and private individuals — i.e. a commercial alternative to bank-owned collection services. Directly relevant to who physically services the ATM/cash estate. Note two related domains (cit.net.ua and cit-security.ua) that should both be tracked.

source_name: Комсервіс (Comservice) — national security operator, cash collection
why_relevant: Another commercial CIT/security provider publishing its cash-transport service offering; broadens the map of non-bank cash logistics competitors around the ATM estate.

source_name: Oschadbank cash collection & valuables transport (bank-as-CIT-provider)
source_subtype: bank service page with volume disclosures
why_relevant: State bank sells collection services to third parties and publicly states scale figures (reported >31,200 serviced business objects and >6,900 ATMs/terminals of OTHER banks). A rare quantified view of outsourced ATM servicing volumes — and evidence that the largest 'CIT competitor' is itself a bank.

source_name: Sense Bank — official POS-terminal service organisation contacts (help-biz KB)
why_relevant: Bank support article that names the outsourced service organisation(s) handling its merchant POS terminals. Bank knowledge bases of this type are one of the very few places where the bank→service-provider link is stated in public rather than inferred. Pattern is replicable across other UA banks' merchant help centres.

source_name: БМС Консалтінг / БМС Сервіс (BMS Consulting group)
why_relevant: Long-standing Kyiv IT integrator group (BMS Consulting, EDRPOU 24932263; BMS Service, EDRPOU 21470081) doing IT outsourcing, engineering systems, complex projects and service support with a documented history of large bank contracts (e.g. an Oschadbank award reported by nashigroshi.org). Also carries reputational/debarment history worth flagging when assessing partners.

source_name: Інком (Incom) — nationwide Ukrainian system integrator
why_relevant: One of Ukraine's largest system integrators (founded 1990, 28 regional branches per Ukrainian Wikipedia) serving the financial sector; regional footprint matters for who can physically service a national ATM/POS estate. Site typically publishes solutions, partners and project references.

source_name: ІТ-Інтегратор (IT-Integrator)
why_relevant: Self-described largest developer/supplier of IT solutions for Ukraine's corporate and state sectors, on the systems-integration market since 2000. Relevant as a competitor for bank IT infrastructure and as a pointer to vendor partnerships (also listed as a reseller on megatrade.ua distributor directory).

source_name: Softline IT Ukraine (softline.kiev.ua)
why_relevant: Ukrainian integrator (since 1995) publishing articles on integrating ERP with bank client systems and naming the banks it has integrated with. Its blog is a soft case-study stream revealing bank-side integration work.

source_name: Selfservice4u — Ukrainian self-service terminal manufacturer
why_relevant: Domestic manufacturer of payment terminals / automated cash kiosks (10+ years, UkrSEPRO and CE certified) — evidence that part of the UA self-service estate is locally built rather than imported, a competitive factor for foreign vendors.

source_name: ТОВ «КУБ ТЕК» (kubek.com.ua) — payment terminal manufacturer
why_relevant: Second domestic PTKS (payment self-service terminal) manufacturer with 10+ years' production. Reinforces the local-manufacture segment; listing sits on the prom.ua marketplace layer, useful as a discovery channel for smaller vendors.

source_name: Printec Ukraine LLC (ПРІНТЕК УКРАЇНА ЕЛ.ЕЛ.СІ., EDRPOU 35442628)
source_subtype: multinational integrator UA entity + registry card
why_relevant: The multinational transactional-technology integrator's Ukrainian entity (founded 2007), serving financial institutions, retail, telecom and government. Its own site and the group's UA financial-results disclosures are the reference point against which local integrator competitors should be benchmarked. NOTE: 'printec.com.ua' and 'printec.ua' are unrelated Ukrainian businesses with a colliding name — do not conflate.

source_name: Prozorro public procurement — ATM/POS maintenance tender search
why_relevant: State banks (Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank, Privatbank, Ukreximbank) and state bodies procure ATM/POS supply and maintenance through Prozorro. Tender notices and award records name the winning integrator/service company, the equipment brands and the contract value — the single hardest-evidence source for who actually holds UA service contracts. Open API available.
